description: Bundle envelopes with WebAuthn ES256 entries, verified in the order of docs/CRYPTO.md §7.3 against the pinned signers listed here (`pinned` names them). Each rejecting case fails exactly one check; all other fields are signed correctly. `signers` also holds one Ed25519 signer for the cross-algorithm cases. A passkey signer pins `rpId` and `origins` (§7.1).
notice: TEST ONLY — every key in this file is derived from a public label. Never use it anywhere else.
